items.text:
Changed review to thumbs up. Earlier patches had some seriously terrible space fantasy elements that could easily be gamebreaking without the player being aware of it happening. Latest patch has not removed the silly space fantasy but has however fixed the major core issue I had with it.

When you put the terrible space fantasy to the side you will find possibly the single most immersive hard sci-fi game in existence. The salvage core game loop in the early/mid game is a lot of fun - far more than any other game that has attempted the genre. Starting with a terrible ship, an overpriced mortgage, and unfortunate health problems has never been more relatable.

Current inter-planet travel is still lacking and would require a lot more to make it tempting after the first few times but I believe it will see further development - and even if the game froze in its current state today the purchase is totally worth it given the current core game loop and fun to be had.
items.text_zh:
把评测改成了好评。早期的补丁有一些极其糟糕的太空奇幻元素，在玩家不知情的情况下很容易导致游戏无法继续。最新的补丁并没有移除那些愚蠢的太空奇幻内容，但确实修复了我对它所抱有的主要核心问题。

当你把那些糟糕的太空奇幻放到一边时，你会发现这可能是现存最具沉浸感的硬科幻游戏。游戏前中期的打捞核心循环非常有趣——远超任何其他尝试过这一类型的游戏。从一艘糟糕的飞船、一笔定价过高的抵押贷款和不幸的健康问题开始，从未如此令人感同身受。

目前的星际旅行仍然有所欠缺，需要在最初几次之后提供更多内容才能让它保持吸引力，但我相信它还会得到进一步开发——而且即使游戏今天就停留在当前状态，鉴于当前的核心游戏循环和可获得的乐趣，这次购买也完全值得。
